text: 国家发展改革委政策研究室副主任李超在发改委8月份例行发布会上表示，机器人产业涉及人工智能、先进制造、新材料等诸多前沿技术，必须因地制宜，健康有序发展，立足本地的资源禀赋和产业优势，找准定位，发挥优势，防止盲目跟风、一哄而上，切实推动相关行业行稳致远。
text_en: Li Chao, Deputy Director of the NDRC Policy Research Office, said at the August regular press conference that the robotics industry involves cutting-edge technologies such as AI, advanced manufacturing and new materials. Development must be tailored to local conditions and proceed in a healthy and orderly manner, based on local resource endowments and industrial strengths, with accurate positioning and advantage-building, to avoid blind imitation and herd behavior and ensure steady and sound industry development.
